tagline.en: See clearly, then move with care.

description.zh: 把目光放回眼前，安静也可以很有力量。
description.en: Look at what is in front of you. Quiet can be a kind of strength.

editorial.promiseEn: See clearly, then move with care.
editorial.storyZh: 露琪亚总会先看清眼前的事情，再决定什么时候出手。到了桌边，这份认真变成了一个小小的点头、一次仔细的侧望，和在你犹豫时耐心停下的脚步。她不喜欢把每个问题都说得很大，也不会因为一点挫折就急着改变方向。有时一护已经准备向前，她还会抬起手，提醒大家再确认一次；等到路真的看清了，她又会毫不迟疑地跟上。白刀轻轻扬起时，寒气把周围变得宁静，雪白的姿态里仍是熟悉的坚定目光。力量收起之后，她整理好衣袖，继续安静站在你身边。今天的节奏可以慢一点，重要的是知道自己正在往哪里走。
editorial.storyEn: Rukia looks carefully before deciding when to act. At the desk, that attention becomes a small nod, a thoughtful glance and a patient pause when you hesitate. She does not make every difficulty sound enormous, nor does one setback send her in a new direction. Sometimes Ichigo is already moving when she raises a hand to check once more. Once the way is clear, she follows without hesitation. Her white blade rises, the air grows quiet, and familiar resolve remains in her snow-white form. When that power settles, she straightens her sleeve and stays beside you. The pace can be gentle when the direction is clear.
editorial.comfortZh: 把目光放回眼前，安静也可以很有力量。
editorial.comfortEn: Look at what is in front of you. Quiet can be a kind of strength.

moments.bodyZh: 先确认最关键的一处，再慢慢展开。
moments.bodyEn: Check the important detail before moving on.

moments.bodyZh: 不必急着回应，留一点时间把想法理顺。
moments.bodyEn: There is time to let your thoughts settle before answering.

moments.bodyZh: 白霞罚展开，雪白衣袖与寒气一同舒展。
moments.bodyEn: Hakka no Togame unfolds in white robes and rising cold.

editorial.matchZh: 适合梳理思绪、检查细节，或想把步调放稳的时候。
editorial.matchEn: For sorting thoughts, checking details or finding a steadier pace.
